title: Grok shares initial seven minutes of AI video Odyssey
excerpt: Grok has made the first seven minutes of its artificial intelligence-generated project, Odyssey, available to the public.
body_html:
Grok has released the first seven minutes of its artificial intelligence-generated video project titled Odyssey.

Early impressions of the footage note that the visual quality appears acceptable, though reviewers point out that the material lacks deep artistry, human interest, and inspiration.

The release offers an early look at the capabilities of the system in generating longer-form video content.
